The framed 7–9 row at the top of the right column continues the same two-column Die Roll / Result table from the lower left column. A vertical divider, aligned column widths, light shading, and the bottom and side borders preserve the cell grouping.

Two separate grey-outline hexagons show the same illustrated elephant counter. The left counter is upright and centered in its hex. The right counter is turned clockwise by approximately 30 degrees and centered in a second hex; its top edge is parallel to the upper-right sloping hexside. Each square counter has a black outline and grey-green background, an elephant and rider drawing, and colored statistic fields. Six direction numbers surround the right hex. Text and number transcriptions are recorded separately; the caption identifies this as a refacing example following a Rampage die roll of 1.
